findings.title: Add monorepo CI that runs package unit tests

locations.snippet: ≥95% coverage … Same bar for Go CLI packages under test when CI lands.

findings.current_state: The only monorepo GitHub Actions workflow is package split/mirror. There is no workflow that runs `composer test`, `composer test:cli`, tools Python tests, PHPStan, or coverage. AGENTS.md and root README document local unit suites as the contract, but CI does not execute them.
findings.recommended_state: Add a `tests.yml` (or matrix job) on PR + push to main that installs PHP deps, runs Pest for core and messaging, runs Go tests for the CLI, and fails the job on non-zero exit. Optionally run `python3 -m unittest` under `tools/tests/`.
findings.rationale: Hundreds of unit tests exist in-package (222 core, 32 messaging, 41 Go) but nothing stops a green local machine or a bad push from becoming the source of truth. For a monorepo that auto-mirrors to public package remotes, missing test CI is a primary reliability gap.
findings.implementation_hint: Create `.github/workflows/tests.yml` with jobs: (1) php: setup-php 8.2 + pcov, `composer install`, `composer test:core`, `composer test:messaging`; (2) go: setup-go from go.mod, `go test ./...` in packages/capabilities-cli; gate split on `needs: [php, go]` or require branch protection requiring the tests check.

findings.title: Gate package split/publish on green tests

locations.snippet: Push to monorepo `main` | split-packages.yml rsyncs each packages/<name>/ tree

findings.current_state: `split-packages.yml` runs on every push to `main` and every `v*` tag and force-pushes package trees (and tags) to rawphp/laravel-capabilities, messaging, and capabilities-cli with no prior test job. Broken or untested code can land on consumer-facing remotes and Packagist-bound tags immediately.
findings.recommended_state: Either make split a dependent job that `needs:` a tests workflow, or use a single workflow with `test` then `split`, and require the tests status check on `main` via branch protection. Tags that fail tests must not mirror.
findings.rationale: Ship model is monorepo → public package remotes on push. Without a quality gate, the split is a deploy path, not just a mirror. Severity is high because consumers install from those remotes (VCS/dev-main today).
findings.implementation_hint: Refactor into `jobs: test: …` then `split: needs: [test]`; for tags, fail closed if tests fail so `--force` tag push never runs. Document in docs/versioning.md Packagist checklist.

findings.title: Run go test before CLI GoReleaser release
findings.current_state: After monorepo tag mirror, the package-owned release workflow checks out, sets up Go, optionally notes signing secrets, and immediately runs GoReleaser. It never runs `go test ./...`.
findings.recommended_state: Add a step `go test ./...` (with race optional) before GoReleaser; fail the job if tests fail so no broken multi-arch binaries are published.
findings.rationale: CLI GitHub Releases are the documented install path for end users. Releasing without unit tests undoes the monorepo’s strong unit-test policy at the only binary ship boundary.
findings.implementation_hint: In release.yml after setup-go: `working-directory` root, `run: go test ./...`. Prefer `go-version-file: go.mod` for alignment with module Go 1.22.

findings.title: Add MIT LICENSE files to monorepo and split packages
findings.current_state: All PHP composer.json files declare `"license": "MIT"`, but no `LICENSE` / `LICENSE.md` file exists at monorepo root or under any package tree (`git ls-files` has none). After split, public package repos will also lack a LICENSE file. Go module has no SPDX file either.
findings.recommended_state: Add a standard MIT LICENSE file at monorepo root and copy/symlink the same into each of `packages/laravel-capabilities`, `packages/laravel-capabilities-messaging`, and `packages/capabilities-cli` so split remotes ship a clear license grant.
findings.rationale: Packagist, GitHub license detection, and many corporate OSS policies require a LICENSE file, not only a composer.json field. Missing file blocks or confuses adoption of intended public packages.
findings.implementation_hint: Use the same MIT text with copyright holder `rawphp` (or org legal name) in four paths; ensure split rsync includes LICENSE. Reference it from each package README footer.

findings.title: Enforce ≥95% coverage in CI (policy is unenforced)

locations.snippet: Minimum: 95% unit-test coverage on package source … Below 95% is a failed task
scripts test / test:core / test:messaging / test:cli — no coverage flags

findings.current_state: AGENTS.md makes ≥95% line coverage blocking. phpunit.xml includes source dirs for coverage but has no coverage report config, composer scripts do not pass `--coverage-text` / min thresholds, no pcov/xdebug is required in require-dev, and no CI job measures coverage. Coverage is only approached via ad-hoc CoverageBoost tests.
findings.recommended_state: CI runs Pest with PCOV and fails if coverage for each package `src/` is below 95%. Go uses `go test -coverprofile` with a minimum check. Document exact commands next to AGENTS.md policy.
findings.rationale: Policy without automation will drift: new code can ship under 95% while still greening `composer test`. Monorepo explicitly treats coverage floor as non-negotiable.
findings.implementation_hint: e.g. `pest --configuration=packages/laravel-capabilities/phpunit.xml --coverage --min=95` with php-actions/setup-php coverage: pcov; for Go: `go test ./... -coverprofile=c.out` + `go tool cover -func` threshold script.

findings.title: Stop gitignoring monorepo composer.lock
findings.current_state: Root `.gitignore` excludes `/composer.lock`. The lockfile exists locally (composer.lock present) but is not tracked. Package libraries correctly omit their own locks; the monorepo root is a `type: project` workspace used for shared Pest/PHPStan and path packages.
findings.recommended_state: Commit root `composer.lock` (remove ignore line) so contributor and CI installs resolve the same illuminate/pest/phpstan graph. Keep package trees lock-free for library publish.
findings.rationale: Ignoring the monorepo lock produces non-reproducible CI and 'works on my machine' drift across Illuminate 11/12 minors while developing path packages.
findings.implementation_hint: Delete `/composer.lock` from `.gitignore`, `composer update` once on PHP 8.2, commit lock. CI should `composer install --prefer-dist` not `update`.

findings.title: Align Illuminate version constraints across packages
findings.current_state: Core advertises Laravel 11–13 illuminate components; messaging and monorepo root only allow 11–12. Messaging can refuse a host that core accepts, and monorepo dev cannot exercise the core ^13 constraint.
findings.recommended_state: Single documented support matrix (e.g. ^11|^12 or ^11|^12|^13) applied identically to core, messaging, and monorepo root require lines.
findings.rationale: Sibling packages that always ship together must not claim divergent host support; consumers will hit confusing Composer solver failures on Laravel 13.
findings.implementation_hint: Either drop `|^13.0` from core until tested, or add `|^13.0` to messaging + root and note matrix in package READMEs / docs/versioning.md.

findings.title: Wire PHPStan (config + CI); cover messaging package

locations.snippet: PHPStan max on package code when CI lands.

findings.current_state: phpstan/phpstan is in monorepo and core require-dev, but there is no `phpstan.neon` / `phpstan.neon.dist` anywhere outside vendor, no composer script, and no CI job. Messaging has no phpstan dep. AGENTS.md defers 'PHPStan max … when CI lands' — residual still open.
findings.recommended_state: Add package-level (or monorepo paths) phpstan.neon at max level for both PHP packages, composer scripts `analyse` / `analyse:core` / `analyse:messaging`, and a CI job. Messaging should require-dev phpstan like core.
findings.rationale: Static analysis is declared as a quality bar for package code but is inert today; install cost without enforcement.
findings.implementation_hint: phpstan.neon with paths packages/*/src, level max; baseline file if needed; `"analyse": "phpstan analyse"` in root composer.json; add to tests workflow.

findings.title: Add Dependabot or Renovate for Composer and Go modules
findings.current_state: No `.github/dependabot.yml` or Renovate config. PHP and Go dependency bumps are fully manual. Actions used (`actions/checkout@v4`, `setup-go@v5`, `goreleaser-action@v6`) also have no automated update path.
findings.recommended_state: Enable Dependabot for composer (root + packages if published separately), gomod for capabilities-cli, and github-actions ecosystem on the monorepo (and after split, on package remotes if they diverge).
findings.rationale: Public packages and a token-holding split workflow need timely Action and library updates; manual-only hygiene will lag.
findings.implementation_hint: Add `.github/dependabot.yml` with weekly composer, gomod (`/packages/capabilities-cli`), and github-actions entries; group minor/patch if noise is high.

findings.title: Add SECURITY.md for public package vulnerability reporting

locations.snippet: Public package repos: rawphp/laravel-capabilities, messaging, capabilities-cli
Package README has no Security section / SECURITY.md link

findings.current_state: No SECURITY.md (or security contact) in monorepo or any package. Packages are intended for public remotes and handle authz, approvals, Telegram secrets, CLI tokens — high-value security surface once published.
findings.recommended_state: Add SECURITY.md at monorepo root and in each package tree (ships via split) with private reporting channel and supported versions (0.x policy).
findings.rationale: GitHub advisory UI and security-conscious consumers expect a documented disclosure path before Packagist listing.
findings.implementation_hint: Standard GitHub SECURITY.md template; private email or GitHub Security Advisories for rawphp org; mirror into packages/* so split remotes inherit it.

findings.title: Add .gitattributes export-ignore for Composer package trees

locations.snippet: Root has .gitignore; no .gitattributes at monorepo or package roots

findings.current_state: No `.gitattributes` anywhere. When packages are installed from source/dist archives, tests, coverage boosters, phpunit.xml, and possibly .github can bloat installs unless export-ignore is set on each package remote.
findings.recommended_state: Per-package `.gitattributes` with `export-ignore` for `/tests`, `/phpunit.xml`, `/.github` (except when release workflow must live in repo — keep workflows, ignore test noise), `/.phpunit.cache`, etc.
findings.rationale: Library packaging hygiene; reduces consumer install size and accidental reliance on test-only files. Split remotes need the file inside each package path.
findings.implementation_hint: Place `packages/laravel-capabilities/.gitattributes` (and messaging) with lines like `/tests export-ignore`. CLI may export-ignore `*_test.go` only if desired — often Go keeps tests in module.

findings.title: Pin Go version in CLI release workflow to go.mod
findings.current_state: Release builds with `go-version: stable` (floating latest stable toolchain) while the module declares `go 1.22`. Binary artifacts can silently change language/runtime behavior across releases without a go.mod bump.
findings.recommended_state: Use `go-version-file: go.mod` (or an explicit `1.22.x`) so releases match the module’s supported toolchain.
findings.rationale: Reproducible multi-arch releases and fewer 'works on CI stable, fails on older go' surprises for source builders.
findings.implementation_hint: In setup-go step: `go-version-file: go.mod` and drop `go-version: stable`.

findings.title: Avoid cancel-in-progress for tag split concurrency

locations.snippet:
if [[ "$SOURCE_REF_TYPE" == "tag" ]]; then
  git -C "$work" tag -f "$tag"
  git -C "$work" push origin "refs/tags/${tag}" --force

findings.current_state: Concurrency groups by ref with `cancel-in-progress: true`. A rapid re-push of the same tag or overlapping workflow_dispatch can cancel an in-flight rsync + force-tag push mid-matrix, leaving package remotes partially updated across the three packages (fail-fast is false but cancel aborts jobs).
findings.recommended_state: Keep cancel-in-progress for branch `main` if desired, but set `cancel-in-progress: false` for tags (or separate concurrency groups) so release mirrors complete atomically per package matrix.
findings.rationale: Tag mirror is the Packagist/version boundary; partial three-way sync is worse than queued sequential runs.

findings.title: Document messaging env vars in a package .env.example
findings.current_state: `.env` is correctly gitignored and `!.env.example` is allowed, but no `.env.example` exists anywhere. Telegram tokens/webhook secrets and host capability env keys are only discoverable by reading config PHP or user-guide prose.
findings.recommended_state: Add `packages/laravel-capabilities-messaging/.env.example` (and optionally core) listing keys with empty/placeholder values, no real secrets.
findings.rationale: Host integrators need a checklist of required secrets; empty examples reduce misconfiguration of webhook security. Not critical because this is a library, not a deployable app.
findings.implementation_hint:
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=
TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET=
CAPABILITIES_MESSAGING_AGENT_PROFILE=support
# never set CAPABILITIES_SKIP_BOOT_CHECKS in production

findings.title: Add CONTRIBUTING.md pointing at monorepo test commands
findings.current_state: Strong README, docs/, and AGENTS.md exist, but there is no CONTRIBUTING.md for human contributors covering PR expectations, unit-only policy, package split implications, and required local checks.
findings.recommended_state: Short CONTRIBUTING.md at monorepo root (and a one-liner in package READMEs linking to monorepo CONTRIBUTING for source development).
findings.rationale: Open-source multi-package intent benefits from a human entrypoint that is not agent-policy prose.
findings.implementation_hint: Cover: fork/clone, composer install, go test, unit-only rule, no feature/DB tests, do not commit secrets, PR must keep package docs self-contained after split.

findings.title: Add Laravel Pint (or document deliberate absence)
findings.current_state: No first-party Pint config or script. laravel/pint appears only transitively in the local lock via other packages, not as a project tool. No formatter CI.
findings.recommended_state: Require-dev `laravel/pint`, add `pint.json` if needed, composer script `format`, and optional CI `--test` mode — or explicitly document in AGENTS.md that formatting is editor-only.
findings.rationale: Laravel package ecosystem norm; reduces style noise in large core package (151 PHP src files). Low severity pre-Packagist.
findings.implementation_hint: `composer require --dev laravel/pint` at monorepo; `"format": "pint"`, `"format:check": "pint --test"` on packages/*/src.

findings.title: Fail closed early when SPLIT_GITHUB_TOKEN is missing
findings.current_state: Workflow documents the secret in comments but does not assert non-empty `SPLIT_TOKEN` before clone/push. Empty secret yields opaque git auth failures mid-job after rsync work.
findings.recommended_state: First run step: if `SPLIT_TOKEN` empty, echo clear setup instructions and `exit 1`.
findings.rationale: Operator DX for monorepo setup residual; reduces time-to-diagnose misconfigured forks/mirrors.
findings.implementation_hint: After `set -euo pipefail`: `if [[ -z "${SPLIT_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then echo 'Set repo secret SPLIT_GITHUB_TOKEN'; exit 1; fi`

notes: Scope: Laravel package monorepo + Go CLI — not a full application. Skipped or N/A for package libraries: frontend a11y, frontend bundle budgets, app APM/Sentry (host concern), Docker/Forge deploy, staging schema drift. Secrets scan found no real API keys; only test tokens (e.g. packages/capabilities-cli/internal/api/api_test.go). .env correctly gitignored. Database migrations under packages/laravel-capabilities/database/migrations look well-indexed with PKs (approvals, idempotency, audit_outbox); messaging migrations dir is empty (.gitkeep only). Docs quality is strong (docs/spec.md, versioning, per-package user guides, CHANGELOGs); relative monorepo links from packages appear avoided. No git tags yet on monorepo. Commit messages in recent history are structured (REQ-*/merge/chore), not wip/fix noise. Observability/ops findings intentionally omitted as residual for consumer apps, not the package bus itself.
